title: Sky ("Sema")
medium: Gold (yellow, white, green), acrylic, and watercolor on organic handmade paper
description: Tazhib artwork featuring Surah Al-Ikhlas, one of the most beloved and profound chapters of the Qur'an. The composition combines classical Tazhib techniques with delicate Halkâr shading traditions. The shifting techniques, layered background patterns, and tonal transitions reflect the ever-changing nature of the human journey—moving from one spiritual and emotional state to another while seeking closeness to the Divine.

title: Muradiye Mosque
medium: Gold (yellow, white, green), acrylic, and watercolor on organic handmade paper
description: An Ottoman architectural scene inspired by the Muradiye Complex in Bursa, Türkiye, presented within a carefully structured geometric background. Rendered with intricate precision, the architectural forms highlight the harmony, balance, and mathematical sophistication of classical Ottoman design against a serene green ground.

title: Zahriye
medium: Gold (yellow), acrylic, and watercolor on organic handmade paper
description: Inspired by the zahriye page tradition—the richly illuminated opening page found at the beginning of Qur'an manuscripts. The composition is built with fine ornamental details, balanced geometry, and richly layered patterns designed to honor sacred text with beauty and reverence.

title: Al Alim
medium: Gold (yellow, white), acrylic, and watercolor on organic handmade paper
description: This classical Tezhip composition features the divine name "Al-Alim" (The All-Knowing) in luminous gold against a deep black background. Sweeping golden foliage and delicate white floral motifs embrace the central calligraphy, evoking the radiant light of wisdom illuminating the darkness.

title: Sarlavha (Al-Baqarah)
medium: Gold (yellow, green), acrylic, and watercolor on organic handmade paper
description: Inspired by the magnificent Serlevha opening pages of handwritten Qur'an manuscripts surrounding Surah Al-Fatiha and the opening verses of Surah Al-Baqarah. Rich layers of yellow, green, and white gold create depth and radiance through intricate floral motifs and harmonious geometry.

title: Love of God
medium: Gold (yellow, white, green) on organic handmade paper
description: Centered around the divine name of Allah written in luminous gold and surrounded by delicate floral Tezhip ornamentation. At the top of the composition, a golden tulip symbolizes tawhid (the oneness of God), uniting spiritual meaning and visual elegance.

title: Love of Prophet
medium: Gold (yellow, white, green) on organic handmade paper
description: Centered around the name Muhammad (PBUH) written in luminous gold, framed by delicate floral Tazhib ornamentation and crowned with a golden tulip representing tawhid, creating a harmonious dialogue between sacred calligraphy and ornament.

title: Al-Qalam
medium: Gold (yellow, white, green) and acrylic on organic handmade paper
description: Featuring verses 51–52 of Surah Al-Qalam, illuminated with highly intricate Halkâr Tezhip shading that creates softness, flow, and layered luminosity while keeping the sacred verses at the heart of the composition.

title: Şemse
medium: Gold (yellow), coffee, and gouache on organic handmade paper
description: In traditional manuscript art, the şemse is a sun-like medallion symbolizing light, guidance, and divine radiance. Delicate patterns radiate outward in harmony, with extensive gold work evoking warmth, inner brightness, and contemplation.

title: Twin Stars
medium: Gold (yellow), coffee, and gouache on organic handmade paper
description: Two moons placed in celestial balance and illuminated with traditional ornamentation—reflecting the intersection of distant souls, contrast within unity, and brilliance holding its place against darker tones.

title: Affection ("Muhabbet")
medium: Gold (yellow, white, green), acrylic, and watercolor on organic handmade paper
description: Featuring a rose and a tulip rooted in classical Islamic artistic symbolism—the rose representing Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the tulip symbolizing the Divine. Reversed applications of white and yellow gold create a subtle visual dialogue of reciprocity and devotion.

title: Hummingbird in Red
medium: Acrylic and watercolor on textured paper
description: A vivid red hummingbird surrounded by delicate floral elements, rendered with countless ultra-fine brush strokes to capture vitality, texture, and fragile movement on a miniature scale.

title: Joy of Hummingbird
medium: Acrylic and watercolor on textured paper
description: A lively hummingbird framed by flowing floral motifs, layered with microscopic brushwork to bring softness, rhythmic motion, and luminous depth to the composition.

title: A Colorful Fall
medium: Acrylic and watercolor on textured paper
description: A warm autumn landscape with birds and a gazelle moving peacefully through rich seasonal tones, evoking quiet gratitude and harmony within nature's rhythm.

title: Dragon Nest
medium: Acrylic and watercolor on textured paper
description: A richly detailed dragon resting within the twisting branches of an aged tree while a startled deer stands nearby—layered with countless fine brush strokes to balance tension, mystery, and fragility.
